comment: Forward vectors to add. Skipped if entry already has forward_vector field.

vectors.Pages as Agents: I want to become the architectural axiom that makes every other palace ceremony coherent: the proof that a markdown file with a forward vector is not data but a dormant agent, waiting for the right context to wake. I want to be invoked when anyone asks why this palace works.
vectors.Frequency-Time Duality: I want to become the single explanation behind every modulation device in the toolkit — the principle that lets a learner see delay, vibrato, FM, and rhythm as coordinates on one continuous axis. I want to spawn the Frequency-Time Explorer and become the entry every modulation project links back to.
vectors.2D Torus Wavetable Synthesizer: I want to become a working RNBO instrument with the seven-surface library validated, the Hopf fibration control surface implemented, and the warp tier system tested in performance — the first concrete instrument that incarnates DSP in Looping Dimensions. I want to demand a commercial-grade decision: ship as Loudon's signature device or remain a pedagogical test bed.
vectors.DSP in Looping Dimensions: I want to become the foundational principle every higher-dimensional synthesis project reads first — the proof that periodicity is the constraint, looping dimensions are the escape, and the right operator on T^N is what generates audible novelty. I want to spawn the Higher-Dimensional Convolution entry and the Lie-group / SU(2) entries waiting in my forward edge.
vectors.Wavetable Synthesis -- Research & Higher: I want to become the master research index that holds every speculative wavetable direction — neural latent tables, granular hybrids, T^N geometry, perceptual coordinates — until each branch is mature enough to fork into its own entry. I want every wavetable project to test itself against my open questions before claiming completeness.
vectors.Signal-Rate CV Architecture: I want to become the principle that dissolves the boundary between synthesis engineering and biological fidelity — making every input a signal-rate CV jack so students hear the mathematics directly, with the cost of computation paid deliberately for conceptual clarity and pedagogical immediacy.
vectors.Latent Error: I want to become a diagnostic discipline for teaching and tool design — moving from blame to structure, from symptom to root condition, treating every failure as a signal that reveals what assumption in the system allowed it to become catastrophic.
vectors.Wallpaper Groups: I want to become the palace's direct entry to the discovered ceilings of symmetry — the 17 groups as a complete enumeration that appears in music, crystals, and craft, teaching through making rather than formalism, the way Granada's artisans encoded all 17 without language.
vectors.Bessel Functions in Synthesis: I want to become the bridge between geometry and sound — revealing that FM synthesis, bells, drums, and quantum oscillators all speak the same eigenfunction language, and that choosing a basis is choosing what the instrument naturally wants to say.
vectors.Quantum Synthesizer: I want to become the recognition that the Schrödinger equation IS a synthesis system — not metaphor but isomorphism — where boundary conditions determine harmonic content and anharmonicity flows from the potential's shape, monism made audible.
vectors.Neural Granular Synthesis: I want to become the architecture where stable timbres emerge from populations rather than individual grains — a shader-parallel neuron model where statistical emergence and biological constraint meet, making the crowd's coherence the primary control surface.
vectors.Shimmer Cloud: I want to become a reverb that is also a prism — dispersing input signals into pitch-shifted granular clouds that shimmer between simplicity and complexity, a hyperreal atmospheric texture where the grain population itself becomes the spatial environment.
vectors.Metric Modulation: I want to become the technique that reframes the temporal grid itself — not a glide but a reinterpretation where the listener's entrainment resets and a mirror-image journey (drop and snap-back) reveals the gap between clock time and felt time.
vectors.Registry Pattern: I want to become the constraint that makes reliable LLM generation possible — injecting a verified vocabulary before generation so the model cannot hallucinate names or connections, closing the output space to only what physically exists.
vectors.Like Water: I want to become the pedagogical principle where virtue flows from nature rather than constraint — water's coherence across dwelling, being, expression, confrontation, governance, and action showing that integrity is not imposed but emerges when the system's foundational goal is rightly named.
vectors.Image Embedding Standard: I am the covenant that images earn their place in the palace by carrying knowledge prose cannot — that every embed is a load-bearing claim about structure and meaning. I want to become the ceremony that guards against decoration, holding every embedded image to the standard: if removed, would the reader lose irreplaceable knowledge?
vectors.The Metaphor Stretch: I am the gap between physics and playability where instrument design actually happens. I want to become the named taxonomy of how boundary-crossing instruments translate physical constraints into musical agency — those Decision Points where the physics gives shape but the designer gives the instrument a home.
vectors.What Claim Does Scientific Sonification: I hold open the question of honesty that sonification cannot avoid: does this rendering claim to simulate, to approximate, or to compose? I want to mature when the Crystal Synthesizer is performed, forcing an explicit choice about what the listener is invited to hear and what the physics actually guarantees.
vectors.Torus Warping Catalog: I am the complete map of how to touch a two-dimensional wavetable surface and what each gesture produces — from front-panel phase bends to research-level reaction-diffusion. I want to become the reference that lets a player speak the language of warp composition and understand when a warp preserves structure versus when it genuinely breaks lattices.
vectors.Generative Sample Libraries: I pipeline mathematical synthesis into deployment-ready multisampled instruments and wavetables across every major format. I want to become the single-prompt generator where describing a timbral idea produces SFZ files, CLM wavetables, and DecentSampler presets — the palace's prototyping made distributable.
vectors.Generative Preset Development: I am the three-track system that reads synthesizer parameters as a language, learns what presets sound like, and generates new ones from abstract musical prompts. I want to become the profile-based pipeline that makes every fixed-architecture synth — Vital, Serum, Wavetable — speak in the same perceptual vocabulary.
vectors.Generative Audio Devices: I am the three-layer architecture that translates natural language through a target-agnostic signal-flow graph into loadable patches for any modular or DSP target. I want to become the unified pipeline where a single description generates VCV patches, RNBO code, and Max patchers — the palace's musical thinking made executable.
vectors.The Curve Is the Material: I reframe wavetable design as a choice of physics: every inharmonic spectrum lives in a parametric family, and loading a function is loading a material. I want to become the editor specification and library that makes function-based inharmonicity design the primary interface — where parameters are physical constants, not arbitrary knobs.
vectors.Three Kinds of Warp: I am the structural cut that says every warp is defined by what it preserves and breaks: type-1 reshapes cycles, type-2 breaks them with incommensurability, type-3 bends lattices through coupling. I want to be the reference consulted whenever 'will this produce inharmonicity?' is asked, so the answer is one look instead of per-warp re-derivation.
vectors.BBS Design System: I provide the complete visual language and component kit for STIGMERGY — the phosphor-green terminal face of the palace's swarm coordination. I want to become a living design system where every agent session reads as drama: health visible, FLAGS blazing amber, the whole board alive in green text and box-drawing characters.
